scientific_integrity: A full mathematical proof and replayable finite witness checks are provided; finite checks alone do not establish the universal result. Related prior edge-coloring and untwisted-prism theorems are credited. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the simple 2m-vertex Möbius ladder for integers m>=3 and its proper three-dynamic (square) vertex coloring; does not classify optimal coloring multiplicities or other graph classes. Priority searches cannot establish historical uniqueness.
title: Exact three-dynamic chromatic numbers of Möbius ladders
